ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_LIGHT_ENERGY.title: Light Energy
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_LIGHT_ENERGY.descr: Comes in Forest, Thunder, Water, and Fire. Some cards spend Light Energy for bonus effects; if you cannot pay, the bonus does not trigger. Each spent point creates a matching Attribute Cell in the Conversion bar.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_ATTRIBUTE_CELL.des:
Each Attribute Cell grants +4% damage for its element.
Fire: For every 4 Fire Attribute Cells, each instance of Fire damage applies 1 [gold]Scorch[/gold].
Water: For every 4 Water Attribute Cells, heal 1 HP at turn end.
Forest: For every 4 Forest Attribute Cells, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to [gold]hand[/gold] size × 1 at turn end.
Thunder: For every 4 Thunder Attribute Cells, each instance of Thunder damage applies 1 [gold]Paralysis[/gold]. Each stack of [gold]Paralysis[/gold] increases Thunder damage taken by 2%.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FOREST_LIGHT_ENERG: Some cards spend Light Energy for bonus effects; if you cannot pay, the bonus does not trigger. Spending it creates a Forest [gold]Attribute Cell[/gold] in the Conversion bar.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_THUNDER_LIGHT_ENER: Some cards spend Light Energy for bonus effects; if you cannot pay, the bonus does not trigger. Spending it creates a Thunder [gold]Attribute Cell[/gold] in the Conversion bar.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_WATER_LIGHT_ENERGY: Some cards spend Light Energy for bonus effects; if you cannot pay, the bonus does not trigger. Spending it creates a Water [gold]Attribute Cell[/gold] in the Conversion bar.
Some cards spend Light Energy for bonus effects; if you cannot pay, the bonus does not trigger. Spending it creates a Fire [gold]Attribute Cell[/gold] in the Conversion bar.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FOREST_ATTRIBUTE_C: Each Forest [gold]Attribute Cell[/gold] grants +4% Forest damage. For every 4 Forest [gold]Attribute Cells[/gold], gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to [gold]hand[/gold] size × 1 at turn end.

ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_WATER_ATTRIBUTE_CE: Each Water [gold]Attribute Cell[/gold] grants +4% Water damage. For every 4 Water [gold]Attribute Cells[/gold], heal 1 HP at turn end.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FIRE_ATTRIBUTE_CEL: Each Fire [gold]Attribute Cell[/gold] grants +4% Fire damage. For every 4 Fire [gold]Attribute Cells[/gold], each instance of Fire damage applies 1 [gold]Scorch[/gold].
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PRISMATIC.title: Prismatic
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PRISMATIC.descript: Prismatic Light Energy counts as any element. Prismatic Attribute Cells count as any attribute. Prismatic damage gains all attribute bonuses and triggers Fire and Thunder special effects. Prismatic Attribute Cells do not combine with Dark Cells or Prism Cells.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_RAINBOW_LIGHT.desc: Triggers when the Conversion bar has all 4 real attributes (each [gold]Prismatic[/gold] cell can fill 1 missing attribute). This turn, each Attribute Cell grants all damage +8%. If all 4 attributes are present and each has at least 2 cells ([gold]Prismatic[/gold] cells fill shortages the same way), this bonus is doubled. At turn end, deal slot-cap × 5 damage to all enemies and reset all Attribute Cells.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PRISM_CELL.title: Prism Cell
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PRISM_CELL.descrip: Adjacent cells count as the same attribute.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DARK_CELL.title: Dark Cell
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_ENHANCED_CELL.desc: Provides a bonus effect for a specific card.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_LOCK.title: Lock
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_LOCK.description: Vice deals +5% damage per stack of Lock to locked enemies.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_TIMELESS_SEAL.desc: A stackable mark. Some effects scale with its stacks.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_AURORA_MOMENT.desc: Whenever you spend [blue]15[/blue] Light Energy, cards in your hand cost 0 this turn and gain Ethereal this turn.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FLYING.title: Flying
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FLYING.description: Attacks deal 50% less damage to you. Lose 1 stack at the start of turn.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_WATER.title: Water
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_THUNDER.title: Thunder
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FIRE.title: Fire
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_HIGH_COURT_GUARD.d: If you have another High Court Guard in hand when played, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FOREST.title: Forest
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PAST_RUPTURE.title: Past Rupture
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PAST_RUPTURE.descr: While in hand, whenever the Conversion bar produces 1 Forest cell, this card's damage increases by 1 for the rest of the run.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_CRYSTALLIZATION_DO: While this card is in your [gold]hand[/gold], whenever an unblocked Forest Attack hits, apply [blue]1[/blue] Crystallization.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_CRYSTALLIZATION.de: At the end of enemy turn, lose 1% Max HP per stack.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_WORD_ABSOLUTE.desc: While in hand, Enhanced Cells you gain are absorbed. Each absorbed cell reduces this card's cost by 1 this combat.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SHADOW_TOWN_TEA_PA: After playing a Tea Party member, the next Tea Party member costs 1 less. This effect has a [blue]1[/blue]-turn cooldown.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_THORN_SEAL_ON_BODY: This card's damage increases by 1 for each Retain effect triggered this combat.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_RADIANT_BLOOM.desc: Each time this card is played, its values increase by 1 for the rest of the run.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DISPLACEMENT_KING_: On the turn after playing, your Forest damage bonus becomes Block bonus.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_EMERALD_MARK.title: Emerald Mark
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PAPER_WOUND.title: Paper Wound
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_PAPER_WOUND.descri: Each stack reduces Max HP by 2 when damage is taken.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_HARVEST_CONSCIOUSN: Each stack lets [blue]10%[/blue] damage bypass [gold]Block[/gold]. Above [blue]10[/blue] stacks, each excess stack increases damage by [blue]10%[/blue]. Enemies without [gold]Block[/gold] take [blue]10%[/blue] more damage per stack.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_NORTHERN_REALM.des: This combat, each Water card gains [gold]Replay[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] the first time it is played.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_POISON_FLOWER_POOL: Attribute Cells created when this card spends Light Energy are always Dark Cells.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_ON_CAPITAL.title: On Capital
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_ON_CAPITAL.descrip: Whenever this card is drawn, levy [blue]20[/blue] Gold and increase this card's damage by [blue]20%[/blue]. On victory, refund at [blue]120%[/blue]. If you die but the party wins, only the principal is refunded.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DIVINE_HAND.title: Divine Hand
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DIVINE_HAND.descri: When played, choose [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and add it to your [gold]hand[/gold].
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SLEEPWALK.title: Sleepwalk
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SLEEPWALK.descript: After play, this card does not go to the [gold]Discard Pile[/gold]; it is [gold]Exhausted[/gold] and returns to your [gold]hand[/gold] after [blue]2[/blue] turns.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_MIRROR_BLOOM.title: Mirror Bloom
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_NIGHTMARE_THORN.de: Each debuff stack on an enemy increases Knarla's final damage by [blue]2%[/blue].
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DRAGON_FANG_MARK.d: Each stack increases final damage against this target by 2%.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FRANK_CLAW.title: Frank Claw
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_FRANK_CLAW.descrip: Each stack makes the target lose equal HP when attacked.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_VELVET_NEEDLE_BASE: Attacks can apply [gold]Antarctic Aurora Velvet Needle[/gold].
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_VELVET_NEEDLE.desc: At end of turn, detonate all stacks at once: deal Water damage equal to stacks and heal the applier for the same amount.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_STRANGE_ANIMAL.des: When this card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold] or [gold]Discarded[/gold], gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_AWAKENING_FORM.des: Whenever you spend 15 Light Energy, reset the Conversion bar with 4 different Attributes.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SOARING.title: Soar
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SOARING.descriptio: Whenever the Light Energy Attribute you spend differs from the last, draw 1 card.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_IGNITION.title: Ignition
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_IGNITION.descripti: Amplify your next Fire damage by 20%, then lose 1 stack.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_BLOOMING_BEGONIA.d: [gold]Ignition[/gold] amplifies Fire damage by an additional [blue]20%[/blue].
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SUPREME_CODEX.desc: After playing, upgrade 1 random card at the end of this combat.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SHADOW_HERD_MAJEST: On play, draw 2 Fire Attack cards from your draw pile.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_BABA_YAGA_COCOON.d: On play, lose 7% current HP as Plating boosted by Fire cells, and gain Energy.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DRAGON_BREATH_ROAR: On play, Exhaust all Statuses; each adds 5% final damage.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_INVESTMENT_RISK.de: On play, Exhaust the bottom card of your draw pile, then draw the top card.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_CLEAR_ALL.title: Clear All!
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_CLEAR_ALL.descript: Spend all Light Energy and fill the Conversion bar with random Dark cells.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_HIGH_NOON.title: High Noon
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_HIGH_NOON.descript: This card's bullet count increases by the number of cards in your Exhaust pile.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_NO_SURVIVORS.title: No Survivors
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_NO_SURVIVORS.descr: Spends all Ignition; each stack adds 15% damage.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_DEAD_CELEBRATION.d: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] half of your deck ([gold]Draw[/gold] and [gold]Discard[/gold] piles), prioritizing [gold]Status[/gold] and [purple]Curse[/purple] cards.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_BOX_MELODY.title: Box Melody
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_BOX_MELODY.descrip: Generate 1 random 0-cost card for each player.
A sword armor with [blue]10[/blue] HP that blocks all damage.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_SILENT_THUNDER.des: Whenever this creature takes damage, it takes additional damage equal to Max HP × [blue]0.5%[/blue] × [gold]Silent Thunder[/gold] stacks.
ALCHEMY_STARS_KEYWORD_LIGHTNING_BEE.desc: At the start of each turn, lose 1 Lightning Bee, gain {thunderLightPrefix:lightIcons(1)}, and draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
This card hits enemies with Imperial Thunder 1 additional time, and consumes 1 Imperial Thunder per hit.
